premise: Snail is slow getting home at dusk; Firefly glows like a lantern beside him all the way, and Mouse walks along.
inspiration: The light in the dark from Andersen's tales, turned wholly warm: a small light that brings friends home instead of fading.
lesson: Being slow is fine when friends go at your pace.

en-US.title: Firefly Lights the Way
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 60s} [softly] The sun had gone down, and slowly, slowly, {snail:enter} Snail was crawling home. {mouse:enter} Mouse scampered beside him, very patiently. {mouse:live} He sniffed the air. He stood on tiptoe to look for the path… then dropped down and washed his face. {mouse:face sad} It's getting dusky, he said. We need a light. {snail:live} Snail tucked into his shell for a rest… waited… then slowly peeked out and looked around. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] A tiny light flew towards them. It was {firefly:enter} Firefly! {mouse:face surprised} [curious] Where's your lamp? asked Mouse. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:wobble} I make my own light! she giggled. {firefly:live hold} She closed her eyes, and her tail glowed brighter and brighter, like a little lantern. {canvas:fireflies 0.7 30s} {sfx:crickets} Her friends came too, blink, blink, blink, until the whole path twinkled. {snail:face happy} {mouse:face happy} [happily] So they went home in the glow, slowly, slowly, and nobody minded one bit. Up on a branch, {owl:enter} Owl {owl:hearts} hooted goodnight, {firefly:live resume} and Firefly dimmed her light and blinked twice.

es-ES.title: Luciérnaga ilumina el camino
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 60s} [softly] El sol ya se había puesto, y despacito, despacito, {snail:enter} Caracol volvía a casa. {mouse:enter} Ratón correteaba a su lado, con mucha paciencia. {mouse:live} Olfateó. Se puso de puntillas para buscar el camino… luego bajó y se lavó la cara. {mouse:face sad} Está oscureciendo, dijo. Necesitamos una luz. {snail:live} Caracol se metió en su concha a descansar… esperó… y asomó despacio y miró a su alrededor. {snail:face surprised} [gasps] Una lucecita venía volando hacia ellos. ¡Era {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga! {mouse:face surprised} [curious] ¿Dónde está tu farolillo?, preguntó Ratón. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:wobble} ¡Yo hago mi propia luz!, se rio. {firefly:live hold} Cerró los ojos, y su colita brilló más y más, como un farolillo. {canvas:fireflies 0.7 30s} {sfx:crickets} Llegaron sus amigas, parpadeo, parpadeo, parpadeo, hasta que todo el camino centelleó. {snail:face happy} {mouse:face happy} [happily] Así volvieron a casa entre lucecitas, despacito, despacito, y a nadie le importó ni un poquito. En una rama, {owl:enter} Búho {owl:hearts} ululó buenas noches, {firefly:live resume} y Luciérnaga fue apagando su luz, y parpadeó dos veces.

crickets.prompt: a soft summer evening meadow with gentle crickets
